blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A 20-year-old college student from Lipa, Batangas was killed by stabbing last week. The unidentified male suspect is at large, according to the spot report obtained by the Inquirer from the Lipa Component City Police Station. The police said they received a report that the victim was found lying along the road of Purok 7 in Brgy. Pinagtong-ulan in Lipa City, Batangas last October 14. The young woman was identified as Jazmine Iya Martinez.
